metadata.title: Adapt 'end-to-end demo' instructions in README to latest version
metadata.author: sl-at-ibm

description:
This PR addresses the code block "End-to-end demo" featured in the README.

Fixes #1512.

The example curl and instructions need to be adjusted to the current structure required to programmatically register a new virtual server; also a virtual server is now accessible via Streamable HTTP, and with sse being deprecated away from MCP, this PR also changes the instructions in that sense.

commits.message:
adapt 'e2e demo' instructions to latest
